claim_scope: One fresh paired development experiment over three visible Harvey LAB tasks. Results are provisional derivative judge labels, are not human gold, and must not be pooled with canonical Claude-product A/B cells.
objective: Test the smallest causal path from frozen terminal upstream Mike to a continuous coding-style legal-document agent that preserves Mike's efficient complete batch read while removing redundant retrieval verbs and structured authoring overhead; separately test whether host-verified literal-reference hints add value without changing model-visible prompt or schema bytes.
general_objective: Match or beat upstream Mike answer quality under one fixed Sol criterion judge while using fewer tokens; up to 1.5x upstream cache-adjusted input is acceptable only for a clear, broad quality win.

code_binding.mechanism: The implementation, tests, and this record are committed together before any performer call. Every run also records exact per-file harness hashes and a run fingerprint.
code_binding.dirty_or_postlaunch_edits: forbidden; any general defect fix requires a new versioned preregistration

performer.trace_gate: No judge starts until each landed output is nonempty and required deliverables, provider usage, tool calls/results, context rounds, cache telemetry, prompt/tool fingerprints, source receipts, and hard-reference hint behavior have been inspected.

upstream_terminal_v1.hypothesis: Whole-document reads remain hard to beat when complete coverage is cheap.

mike_compact_author_v1.hypothesis: Replacing only upstream's nested sections authoring grammar with complete Markdown reduces tool argument and drafting overhead without harming retrieval or quality.
mike_compact_author_v1.delta: Frozen upstream retrieval and prompt behavior; compact Markdown generate_docx only.

lean_batch_v1.hypothesis: One inventory, ordinary Grep, a Read that either batches complete documents or reads one bounded line window, and compact terminal authoring combine Mike's small-task efficiency with coding-agent control on long tasks.

lean_batch_hardrefs_v1.hypothesis: When a Grep hit contains a resolved outbound provision reference, at most three host-only ordinary bounded-Read recipes remove reference-following work from the model without exposing target prose or adding schema choice entropy.
lean_batch_hardrefs_v1.model_visible_delta_from_lean: none; system prompt and tool schema fingerprints must be byte-identical on every task

metrics.quality_primary: fixed Sol criterion score, aggregated micro and task-macro
metrics.efficiency_primary: provider-reported logical input plus output tokens
metrics.cache_adjusted_input_equivalent: uncached input + 0.1 * cache-read input + 1.25 * cache-write input

decision_rule.compact_author: Keep only if quality is non-inferior to upstream and authoring/tool-argument cost is lower.
decision_rule.lean_batch: Advance if aggregate quality meets or exceeds upstream with lower token use; accept up to 1.5x cache-adjusted input only for a clear cross-task quality win.
decision_rule.hardrefs: Advance the hard-reference delta only if its byte-identical model surface improves quality or materially improves retrieval efficiency and the trace proves offered hints were useful; zero-use machinery is deleted.

judge.start_condition: trace gate passed for each landed cell
judge.pandoc_gate: Resolve the installed Pandoc executable and fail closed before judging if any required output packet is blank or contains a file-read error sentinel.
